steps.title: Find a bee nest
steps.say: [Bee nests](item:bee_nest) hang from trees in [meadows](biome:meadow), [plains](biome:plains) and [flower forests](biome:flower_forest). Bees fly in and out of them.

steps.title: Light a campfire under it
steps.say: Put a [campfire](item:campfire) on the ground a few blocks below the nest. The smoke keeps the bees calm.

steps.title: Wait for honey
steps.say: When the nest is full, honey drips out of it and you can see honey on its sides.

steps.title: Get honey
steps.say: Use a [glass bottle](item:glass_bottle) on the full nest to get a [honey bottle](item:honey_bottle).

steps.title: Get honeycomb
steps.say: Or use [shears](item:shears) on the full nest to get 3 [honeycomb](item:honeycomb).

steps.title: Make your own hive
steps.say: Craft a [beehive](item:beehive) from 6 [planks](item:oak_planks) and 3 [honeycomb](item:honeycomb). Hold a flower and bees follow you to it.

steps.title: Plant flowers
steps.say: Plant flowers near the hive so the bees stay busy. They help your crops grow too.
